\[
\frac{1}{\lambda} = R \left( \frac{1}{n_1^2} - \frac{1}{n_2^2} \right)
\]

Here, \( n_1 = 2 \) (lower energy level) and \( n_2 = 6 \) (higher energy level). The Rydberg constant \( R \) is approximately \( 1.097373 \times 10^7 \, \text{m}^{-1} \).

\[
\frac{1}{\lambda} = R \left( \frac{1}{2^2} - \frac{1}{6^2} \right) = R \left( \frac{1}{4} - \frac{1}{36} \right)

   \[
   a = \frac{4r}{\sqrt{3}}
   \]

   \[
   \rho = \frac{Z \cdot M}{N_A \cdot \left(\frac{4r}{\sqrt{3}}\right)^3}
   \]

   \rho = \frac{Z \cdot M \cdot 3^{3/2}}{N_A \cdot 64 \cdot r^3}

\[
